name: Audio Lane (Tympo)
notes: Real audio source. The host renders a Tympo lane onto the rack's sample grid (tympo-lane.js: levelToInput linearly interpolates the published level; hitsToInput renders hits as strength*e^(-t/decay)) and passes it as the per-sample external input (binding 2). The engine then runs smooth -> process -> lag|spring -> outputs as usual. Gate (not Trigger) for C: the trigger look-back does not see per-sample history. Replaces 05-audio-transient-placeholder.
